firstRun.welcomeBody: NEO knows you're writing books. A few quick questions and it will never ask anything again.
firstRun.yourNameHint: (appears as the author on every document — leave blank for “Anonymous”)
firstRun.penNameHint: (optional — used on title pages if set)
firstRun.pantserOrPlotter: Are you a pantser or a plotter?
firstRun.pantserDesc: I write by the seat of my pants. New books open on a blank page.
firstRun.plotterDesc: I outline first. New books open in the Outline tab.
firstRun.pageLookBody: Pick a typeface and a drop-cap style. The sample below shows exactly what you'll get. (Changeable anytime in the Format menu.)
firstRun.changeLater: You can change any of this later. That's it for questions — promise.
firstRun.sampleText: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief…

editor.tabDarlingsTitle: Drag any selection here. It's saved, not gone.
editor.navAddTitle: Add a chapter at the end

editor.stickyEmpty:
No notes yet.

Hit {key} while writing to drop a placeholder — a “come back to this” mark that never breaks your flow.
editor.outlineHint: Enter — new chapter (or section, from a section line) · Tab — turn a fresh chapter line into a section · Shift+Tab — turn a section into a chapter · Backspace on an empty line removes it
editor.darlingsEmpty:
When a beautiful paragraph is gumming up the works, select it and drag it onto the Darlings tab below.
It leaves your manuscript but it is never lost.
editor.newCoverTitle: New cover, woven from the current text
